senses.gloss: h. a. ch. (= מה הו) what is it? how is it? Targ. II Esth. I, 2 (3); a. e.—
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 33b:12">Kidd. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ שיעמוד וכ׳</he> how is it, i.e. must his father stand up before him? <cite ref="Kiddushin 33b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ לעמוד וכ׳</he> must one stand up &c.?—
Y. Yoma III, beg. 40ᵇ מ׳ בורקי what does bor’kay mean?—

<cite ref="Chullin 46a:11">Ḥull. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>מתלקט מ׳</he> how is it if the liver is &c., v. <cite ref="L00677"><he>לָקַט</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—<he>מ׳ דתימא</he> what is it you might think?, i.e. you might be under the impression.

<cite ref="Arakhin 21b:17">Arakh. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ ד׳ בטולי וכ׳</he> you might assume that he annulled (the protest), therefore we are given to understand &c., v. <cite ref="Q02072"><he>פְּשִׁיטָא</he></cite>; a. fr.
